scenarios.name: Hide and restore work-feature entries in the part browser

scenario_steps.name: a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited
the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch
Hide Work Features is unchecked in browser Display Preferences
the user selects Hide Work Features
the Origin branch is hidden from the browser
the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible
the user reopens browser Display Preferences
the user selects Hide Work Features again
the Origin branch returns to the browser in a collapsed state
the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible
